question: Does the applicant need an immigration medical examination?

claims.text: Foreign nationals applying for permanent residence must undergo an immigration medical examination unless exempted under temporary public policy.
claims.quote: We’ve extended the temporary public policy to exempt certain foreign nationals in Canada from the immigration medical examination requirement **until October 5, 2029**.

basis: Submitted eMedical Information Sheet (IMM 1017B) indicates Jane Doe underwent an upfront IME on 2026-01-15 (IME98765432 / UMI NZ-1029384756).
The exam was performed by authorized designated panel physician Dr. Sarah Jenkins, MD (PP-40921) at Metro Health Panel Clinic.
Medical assessment status is cleared/passed with no unresolved furtherance notes or pending specialist reports.
Valid eMedical receipt and IMM 1017B form (IMM1017B-883920) are attached and within the 12-month validity period.
